description: Meeting workflow transitions: submit, approve, reject, publish, cancel and organizer transfer with guards.

cases.inputs: Meeting status: Draft; actor: organizer with MeetingCreator; command: SubmitForApproval with an eligible approver.
preconditions: Meeting is Draft; organizer holds MeetingCreator.
Approver is active, holds MeetingApprover and differs from the organizer.
cases.return: Success(WaitingApproval); assignment recorded in status history; approver notified.

cases.inputs: Meeting status: WaitingApproval; actor: assigned approver with MeetingApprover; command: Approve.
preconditions: Meeting is WaitingApproval with the actor as assigned approver.
Actor holds MeetingApprover and is not the organizer.
cases.return: Success(Approved); approval recorded in status history; organizer notified.

cases.inputs: Meeting status: WaitingApproval; actor: assigned approver; command: Reject with reason "   ".
preconditions: Meeting is WaitingApproval with the actor as assigned approver.

cases.inputs: Meeting status: WaitingApproval; actor: assigned approver; command: Reject with a reason of 1001 characters.
preconditions: Meeting is WaitingApproval with the actor as assigned approver.

cases.inputs: Meeting status: Approved; actor: organizer with MeetingCreator; command: Publish; roster has no active secretary.
preconditions: Meeting is Approved; organizer holds MeetingCreator.
Roster has one active chair and no active secretary.

cases.inputs: Meeting status: WaitingApproval; actor: assigned approver without MeetingApprover; command: Approve.
preconditions: Meeting is WaitingApproval with the actor as assigned approver.
Actor lost MeetingApprover after the assignment.

precondition: Meeting in the required start status with a valid roster; actor with the required capability.
